--- title: "Explorador del Mercado Laboral" format: html: toc: false ```{r} # ============================================================ # EXCAVATALENTO # OBSERVATORIO DEL MERCADO LABORAL DE LA ARQUEOLOGÍA # EXPLORADOR INTERACTIVO # ============================================================ # ============================================================ # 1. PAQUETES # ============================================================ source("../R/00_paquetes.R") library(readr) library(dplyr) library(plotly) library(crosstalk) library(htmltools) # ============================================================ # 2. CARGA DE DATOS # ============================================================ datos <- read_csv( "../data/processed/encuesta_dashboard.csv", show_col_types = FALSE ) datos <- datos |> mutate( id_respuesta = row_number() ) # ============================================================ # 3. DATOS COMPARTIDOS # ============================================================ # SharedData permite que los filtros interactivos # trabajen sobre las mismas 185 respuestas. shared_datos <- SharedData$new( datos, key = ~id_respuesta, group = "observatorio" ) # ============================================================ # 4. PALETA CORPORATIVA # ============================================================ azul <- "#1E2294" azul_oscuro <- "#171C73" azul_claro <- "#4E58C8" texto <- "#222222" gris <- "#666666" fondo <- "#F2ECE2" blanco <- "#FFFFFF" # ============================================================ # 5. CONFIGURACIÓN GENERAL DE LOS GRÁFICOS # ============================================================ layout_base <- list( paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", font = list( family = "Montserrat, Inter, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif", color = texto ), margin = list( l = 20, r = 20, t = 20, b = 80 ) ) # ============================================================ # 6. TÍTULO DEL DASHBOARD # ============================================================ cat("

Explorador del Mercado Laboral

Observatorio de la Arqueología de Colombia · ExcavaTalento

") # ============================================================ # 7. FILTROS # ============================================================ filtro_departamento <- filter_select( id = "filtro_departamento", label = "Departamento", sharedData = shared_datos, group = ~departamento, multiple = TRUE ) filtro_experiencia <- filter_select( id = "filtro_experiencia", label = "Experiencia", sharedData = shared_datos, group = ~experiencia, multiple = TRUE ) filtro_formacion <- filter_select( id = "filtro_formacion", label = "Formación", sharedData = shared_datos, group = ~formacion, multiple = TRUE ) filtro_ingreso <- filter_select( id = "filtro_ingreso", label = "Ingreso", sharedData = shared_datos, group = ~ingreso, multiple = TRUE ) filtro_area <- filter_select( id = "filtro_area", label = "Área de trabajo", sharedData = shared_datos, group = ~area_trabajo, multiple = TRUE ) filtro_activo <- filter_select( id = "filtro_activo", label = "Situación laboral", sharedData = shared_datos, group = ~activo, multiple = TRUE ) # ============================================================ # 8. CONTENEDOR DE FILTROS # ============================================================ div( class = "dashboard-filters", div( class = "dashboard-filter", tags$strong("Departamento"), filtro_departamento ), div( class = "dashboard-filter", tags$strong("Experiencia"), filtro_experiencia ), div( class = "dashboard-filter", tags$strong("Formación"), filtro_formacion ), div( class = "dashboard-filter", tags$strong("Ingresos"), filtro_ingreso ), div( class = "dashboard-filter", tags$strong("Área de trabajo"), filtro_area ), div( class = "dashboard-filter", tags$strong("Situación laboral"), filtro_activo ) ) # ============================================================ # 9. INDICADORES PRINCIPALES # ============================================================ cat("

PARTICIPANTES

185

Respuestas de la encuesta

TERRITORIOS

24

Departamentos representados

VARIABLES

24

Dimensiones analizadas

AÑO

2026

Edición del observatorio

") # ============================================================ # 10. SITUACIÓN LABORAL # ============================================================ cat("

Situación laboral

") plot_ly( data = datos, x = ~activo, type = "bar", source = "activo", marker = list( color = azul ) ) |> layout( layout_base, xaxis = list( title = "", tickangle = -25 ), yaxis = list( title = "Participantes" ) ) # ============================================================ # 11. EXPERIENCIA # ============================================================ cat("

Experiencia profesional

") plot_ly( data = datos, x = ~experiencia, type = "histogram", histfunc = "count", source = "experiencia", marker = list( color = azul ) ) |> layout( layout_base, xaxis = list( title = "", tickangle = -25 ), yaxis = list( title = "Participantes" ) ) # ============================================================ # 12. FORMACIÓN # ============================================================ cat("

Formación

") plot_ly( data = datos, x = ~formacion, type = "histogram", histfunc = "count", source = "formacion", marker = list( color = azul_claro ) ) |> layout( layout_base, xaxis = list( title = "", tickangle = -25 ), yaxis = list( title = "Participantes" ) ) # ============================================================ # 13. INGRESOS # ============================================================ cat("

Ingresos

") plot_ly( data = datos, x = ~ingreso, type = "histogram", histfunc = "count", source = "ingreso", marker = list( color = azul ) ) |> layout( layout_base, xaxis = list( title = "", tickangle = -30 ), yaxis = list( title = "Participantes" ) ) # ============================================================ # 14. ÁREA DE TRABAJO # ============================================================ cat("

Área de trabajo

") plot_ly( data = datos, x = ~area_trabajo, type = "histogram", histfunc = "count", source = "area_trabajo", marker = list( color = azul_claro ) ) |> layout( layout_base, xaxis = list( title = "", tickangle = -40 ), yaxis = list( title = "Participantes" ) ) # ============================================================ # 15. ESTABILIDAD LABORAL # ============================================================ cat("

Estabilidad laboral

") plot_ly( data = datos, x = ~estabilidad, type = "histogram", histfunc = "count", source = "estabilidad", marker = list( color = azul ) ) |> layout( layout_base, xaxis = list( title = "", tickangle = -35 ), yaxis = list( title = "Participantes" ) ) # ============================================================ # 16. TIPO DE EMPRESA # ============================================================ cat("

Tipo de empresa

") plot_ly( data = datos, x = ~tipo_empresa, type = "histogram", histfunc = "count", source = "tipo_empresa", marker = list( color = azul_claro ) ) |> layout( layout_base, xaxis = list( title = "", tickangle = -35 ), yaxis = list( title = "Participantes" ) ) # ============================================================ # 17. DEPARTAMENTO # ============================================================ cat("

Distribución territorial

") plot_ly( data = datos, x = ~departamento, type = "histogram", histfunc = "count", source = "departamento", marker = list( color = azul ) ) |> layout( layout_base, xaxis = list( title = "", tickangle = -45 ), yaxis = list( title = "Participantes" ) ) # ============================================================ # 18. PIE DE PÁGINA # ============================================================ cat("

ExcavaTalento · Observatorio del Mercado Laboral de la Arqueología

Fuente: Encuesta ExcavaTalento · 185 participantes · 2026

") ```
